Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that’s all we have from what turned out to be a thrilling contest, where New Zealand just got the better of West Indies. With the series now locked at 1-1, the stage is perfectly set for an enticing third encounter. The 3rd T20I will take place at the Saxton Oval in Nelson on 9th November, Sunday, starting at 12.15 am GMT. As always, do join us early for all the build-up and pre-match discussions. Until then, take care and goodbye!

Mitchell Santner, the victorious skipper of New Zealand, says that it got really close but credits the West Indies, as they showed once again that they’re never out of the game, especially with the kind of power they possess. Adds that the conditions got a bit dewy toward the end, and the cutters began to skid on a little. Shares that the bowlers need to keep mixing it up and credits the boys who held their nerve brilliantly. Lauds Mark Chapman, who showed great intent right from the start, taking quick singles, using his feet, and keeping the scoreboard ticking. Once he got in, he just went into overdrive. He’s got that license to keep going, and that’s exactly what he did. Closes by adding that the passage of play completely turned the game in their favour.

Shai Hope, the captain of West Indies, says that they almost got over the line. Adds that Rovman Powell, Romario Shepherd, and Matthew Forde were great, but they needed more runs up front. Adds that with the firepower that they have, they can never be written off in any game. Says that Forde was bowling really well, so they wanted to keep him going with the new ball and bowl four overs on the trot.

Mark Chapman is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his amazing knock and three catches in the field. He says that it’s always nice to connect a few out of the middle. Adds that there were some valuable contributions all around. Mentions that Conway and Robinson did a fantastic job negotiating the new ball, as it looked quite tricky early on. Says that it was about trying to throw a few punches and take the game on a bit more. Tells that with the smaller boundaries, we got to play a more fearless brand of cricket. Closes by adding that he’s glad that it came off in this match.
Presentation Time...

New Zealand will be relieved to have held their nerve and crossed the finish line, but there’s no denying that their death bowling remains a concern after almost letting the game slip away. Jacob Duffy and Kyle Jamieson set the tone early with the new ball, with the former striking first to put the visitors on the back foot. The middle overs belonged to the spin duo of Ish Sodhi and Mitchell Santner, who shared six wickets between them and kept things tight. However, once their spells ended, the pressure eased, and the Windies batters took full advantage to mount a strong comeback. It all came down to Jamieson in the final over with 16 to defend - despite a shaky start with a couple of boundaries and a No-Ball, he held his composure to see New Zealand through by the narrowest of margins.

Earlier in the game, after being put in to bat, New Zealand piled up a massive total on the board. The openers began steadily, with Tim Robinson taking the initiative with some crisp strokes, but the real show was stolen by Mark Chapman, who blasted a breathtaking 78 off just 28 balls to completely shift the momentum. A rapid cameo from Daryl Mitchell at the end helped them cross the 200-run mark. For West Indies, Roston Chase picked up a couple of wickets while Matthew Forde was the most economical, conceding only 17 runs in his four overs and grabbing one wicket. Jason Holder and Romario Shepherd also chipped in with one apiece, but collectively, they failed to contain the flow of runs in the middle and death overs.

Losing Brandon King early was far from ideal for the West Indies in their chase. Alick Athanaze tried to inject some momentum, while Shai Hope took his time to get going. The pair added 49 runs for the second wicket, but neither could convert their starts, and a middle-order slump saw them crumble from 49/1 to 93/6. Just when it seemed all over, Rovman Powell and Romario Shepherd turned the game on its head with a stunning six-hitting assault, smashing 10 maximums between them to bring the visitors right back into it. Shepherd’s dismissal came at the wrong time, though, and despite some late fireworks from Matthew Forde, the Windies fell heartbreakingly short by just 3 runs. Powell, who had taken them to the brink, needing only 6 off 3, will be gutted to have missed out on completing a remarkable heist.

What a spectacle we’ve just witnessed at Eden Park! New Zealand have scraped through by the barest of margins to square the series in a contest that went right down to the wire. West Indies, despite being on the back foot for most of the chase, refused to give up and pushed the hosts all the way - a reminder that you can never count them out, especially in this format with the kind of firepower they possess.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Skipper joins the six-hitting party now! Tossed up, full and on middle, Shai Hope goes down on one knee and nails the slog sweep over the deep mid-wicket fece for a biggie.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.4: Michael Bracewell to Shai Hope, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Pushed through quicker, shortish and on off, Shai Hope gets hurried and pats it back to the bowler.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.3: Michael Bracewell to Shai Hope, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Floated, full and on off, Alick Athanaze drills it down to long on for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.2: Michael Bracewell to Alick Athanaze, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Gets it away! Flatter, full and around off. Alick Athanaze goes down for the reverse sweep. Gets it off the bottom edge but it races past short third for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 6.1: Michael Bracewell to Alick Athanaze, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Double change? Yes, time for some spin now as Michael Bracewell comes into the attack.
Pitched up and on off, Alick Athanaze steers it wide of short third for one. West Indies are 36/1 at the end of the Powerplay!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.6: Zakary Foulkes to Alick Athanaze, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on off, Alick Athanaze pats it towards short third.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.5: Zakary Foulkes to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Streaky! Goes fuller and outside off, Alick Athanaze charges down the track and throws his bat at it. Gets an outside edge that flies over short third for a boundary.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.4: Zakary Foulkes to Alick Athanaze, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Nicely bowled! Good length and in the corridor of uncertainty, shapes away a touch, Alick Athanaze tries to push it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.3: Zakary Foulkes to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! A bouncer now, outside off, but too high and maybe too wide as well, Alick Athanaze fails to reach out for it. Wided.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.3: Zakary Foulkes to Alick Athanaze, Wide!

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Into the stands! Short of a length, on middle, sits up nicely for the batter. Alick Athanaze picks up the length early, swivles and pulls it over the deep square leg fence for a biggie.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.2: Zakary Foulkes to Alick Athanaze, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Brilliant fielding! Back of a length and outside off, Alick Athanaze crunches the cut from the middle of the bat wide of point. Tim Robinson flings himself to his left to make a fantastic stop.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 5.1: Zakary Foulkes to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Zakary Foulkes replaces Kyle Jamieson.
Touch fuller and on middle, Shai Hope knocks it towards mid on. Duffy's figures read 3-1-7-1! Super stuff!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.6: Jacob Duffy to Shai Hope, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Bangs in a quick bouncer, outside off, gets some extra bounce again, Shai Hope slashes at it but fails to connect.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.5: Jacob Duffy to Shai Hope, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched up and on middle, swings in a bit, Alick Athanaze uses his feet and drills it to mid off for one.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.4: Jacob Duffy to Alick Athanaze, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Almost chopped on! Back of a length and on off, angling away. Alick Athanaze stays back and tries to steer it too close to his body. Gets a bottom edge that goes onto his pads and almost trickles onto the stumps, but goes just wide.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.3: Jacob Duffy to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on off, Shai Hope pushes it through covers for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.2: Jacob Duffy to Shai Hope, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on middle, Shai Hope backs away, opens the face of the bat and guides it to backward point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Jacob Duffy to Shai Hope, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! And again! Same shot, same result! Fuller in length and on off, Alick Athanaze moves across early and nails the scoop once more over the fine leg fence for half a dozen more.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Kyle Jamieson to Alick Athanaze, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length and on off, Alick Athanaze dabs it to point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Kyle Jamieson to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched up and around off, Alick Athanaze looks to loft it over covers but slices it over point. Mark Chapman in the deep runs to his left and slides to make a good stop. Two taken.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Kyle Jamieson to Alick Athanaze, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Wonderful shot! Fuller in length and on middle, Alick Athanaze moves across to get inside the line of it and plays the scoop perfectly over the keeper's head for a biggie.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Kyle Jamieson to Alick Athanaze, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: BEAUTY! Lands this on a good length and in that channel outside off, holds its line, Alick Athanaze pushes at it with hard hands but the ball zips past the outside edge. There is a slight appeal for LBW, but turned down.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Kyle Jamieson to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller and on middle, Alick Athanaze uses his feet and bunts it down the pitch, where Kyle Jamieson gets a hand to it on the follow-through to make a half-stop.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Kyle Jamieson to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Lovely shot! Slightly fuller in length and on off, Shai Hope leans on to his drive nicely and plays it delightfully. It is in the air for a while, but in the gap between point and cover and races to the fence for the first boundary of the chase.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Jacob Duffy to Shai Hope, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Tries to be cheeky, but does not connect! Short of a length and around off, gets some extra bounce, Shai Hope looks to reverse ramp it but misses it completely.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Jacob Duffy to Shai Hope, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and on off, Alick Athanaze steers it towards point and calls for the run. There is a bit of a hesitation between the batters, but a fumble from Tim Robinson means they get it comfortably.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Jacob Duffy to Alick Athanaze, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Hits the length hard and around middle, jags back in now. Alick Athanaze looks to work it across the line but misses and gets hit on the pads. 9 dots in a row now for Duffy.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Jacob Duffy to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Moves to the other side now! Goes fuller and outside off, shaping away sharply, Alick Athanaze throws his hands at it but misses.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Jacob Duffy to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Good length and on off, nips back in a bit, Alick Athanaze stays back and pats it to the off side.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Jacob Duffy to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and on middle, angling into the batter, Shai Hope gets a bit cramped up and ends up stabbing it onto the pitch.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Kyle Jamieson to Shai Hope, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Extra spice! Kyle Jamieson bangs this into the pitch, outside off, takes off a bit. Shai Hope has a wild swing across the line but gets nowhere near the ball.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Kyle Jamieson to Shai Hope, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched up and around off, Shai Hope strides out and drives it nicely through covers for a brace.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Kyle Jamieson to Shai Hope, 2 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: West Indies are finally underway! Touch fuller and on off, Alick Athanaze opens the face of the bat and runs it down to deep third for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Kyle Jamieson to Alick Athanaze, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and around off, Alick Athanaze guides it towards point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Kyle Jamieson to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: BEATEN! Kyle Jamieson begins with a good-length delivery, straightens after hitting the deck. Alick Athanaze has a poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Kyle Jamieson to Alick Athanaze, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Kyle Jamieson to bowl from the other end.
WICKET-MAIDEN OVER! Jacob Duffy sees the batter back away, serves a fine wide yorker outside off. Shai Hope is too far to reach out for it and misses. Excellent start for the Kiwis!
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Jacob Duffy to Shai Hope, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Hits the length hard, on off, Shai Hope stays back and dabs it towards point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Jacob Duffy to Shai Hope, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on off, Shai Hope guides it off the outer half of the bat towards short third.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Jacob Duffy to Shai Hope, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Shai Hope walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! EDGED AND GONE! Jacob Duffy strikes in the first over! He goes fuller and well outside off. Brandon King just throws his bat at it without any footwork. A nothing shot really and the outside edge is found. The ball goes behind where Devon Conway makes no mistake. King goes back for a duck, and West Indies are 0/1!
Commentary.Howout: c Devon Conway b Jacob Duffy
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Jacob Duffy to Brandon King, OUT! c Devon Conway b Jacob Duffy.

Commentary.Commentary: Lands this on a good length, on middle, Brandon King gets behind the line of it and pats it towards mid on.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Jacob Duffy to Brandon King, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Jacob Duffy starts with a back-of-a-length delivery, around off, Brandon King rides the bounce and steers it towards cover-point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Jacob Duffy to Brandon King, No run.
